answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The lagoon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the river is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
